admission.justification: Five no-counter regression tests pin the absence across backend projection, served schema, fold behavior, store overwrite and metrics; realizations span observer, dashboard and test-tree locations; nothing replaces the counter per rule 2. Admission claims guarded_by_test only: the invariant is proved by named regression tests rather than multi-file realizations.

applicability: Every product-code, fixture, benchmark and test-bound-document location governed by MIK-R115@v1: no computed token counter may exist there, and no code may read, skip or convert an old counter field.
conditions: Absence is asserted by the no-counter regression module and the master-reader absence test at their pinned revisions.
exclusions: Permitted test-side literals (old-field inputs, absent-name assertions), each listed by file, line and kind in the corrected E1 inventory.
Unrelated vendor spellings (Codex notification payload, knowledge-paging thresholds).
Single-event tokens, which stay under MIK-R114 rule 3.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_observer_no_computed_counter.py (5/5); dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/masterSeries.test.tsx 'shows no token total on the master reader' + old-field snapshot test (20/20); worker report + W4 addendum

statement: The computed token counter is removed from the dashboard and the projection: gauge and file, series tokens, cockpit total, TokenSample, tokenSeries, totalTokens, lifecycle tokens with the reducer step, and observer/series_tokens.py with its readers.
